title: Tenant request inbox and durable chunk-store hardening

phases.objective: List tenant tickets and resolution cases as one bounded inbox while retaining independent statuses, enforcing object-level tenant scope, and degrading large tool responses safely when durable chunk schema is incomplete.

e2e_journeys.actor: platform admin or authenticated tenant member
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A bounded ticket/case projection and redacted timeline are returned, while incomplete chunk persistence falls back to bounded inline output instead of failing tools/list.
steps: Authorize the caller against platform-admin or active tenant membership scope.
Detect whether the explicit tenant_resolution_cases.ticket_id link is available and preserve the ticket:// compatibility fallback before migration.
Read tickets ordered by latest activity and stable ticket_id with opaque cursor pagination.
Return ticket status and resolution case status in separate nested objects.
Read ticket, case, and readback timeline rows with tenant-safe redaction and bounded row limits.
Inspect durable chunk-store schema before persistence and return bounded inline output when required columns are unavailable.
Expose the four inbox endpoints through the generated frontend dispatch inventory.
assertions: Ticket open and resolution case escalated remain separate states for the regression ticket.
A tenant cannot read another tenant's request by tenant_id, ticket_id, or resolution_case_id inference.
Cursor pagination uses latest_activity_at plus ticket_id and never OFFSET.
Tenant timelines exclude internal ticket events, case evidence refs, and raw readback states.
The migration is additive and does not delete, archive, or rename existing records.
Chunk schema failures expose typed non-secret diagnostics and do not drop the entire tool-list response.
The generated dispatch inventory contains the admin and tenant request list/detail surfaces.

phases.objective: Provide schema readiness views, typed diagnostics, bounded paging, and stable request identifiers without external mutations.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Migration readiness views and inbox list filters
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Operations can distinguish missing schema from missing data and continue with a bounded response.
steps: Inspect explicit ticket-link and chunk-runtime schema readiness.
List a bounded page with filters and a stable next cursor.
Log only error code, cause code, operation, request id, and source tool key during chunk fallback.
assertions: No response content or credentials are written to fallback diagnostics.
Readiness views report blocked until every required additive column and index is present.
No migration is applied by the runtime code in this change.

phases.objective: Fail closed on authorization and malformed cursors while retaining bounded inline availability during chunk-store schema drift.

e2e_journeys.actor: unauthorized tenant caller or runtime with incomplete chunk schema
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Tenant request detail lookup or governed response chunk persistence
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Unauthorized object access is rejected and chunk persistence degradation is contained without exposing secrets.
steps: Attempt to access a tenant request without an active membership.
Attempt to decode a malformed pagination cursor.
Inspect a chunk table missing one runtime-required ownership column.
Return typed errors or bounded inline response without provider calls.
assertions: Missing chunk columns are listed explicitly with secrets_included=false.
No external provider call, SQL apply, or destructive mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Apply the additive migration in an authorized non-production database and verify the regression ticket appears first with open/escalated states.
Verify exact Production SHA, migration ledger, schema readback, and live tenant/admin inbox responses.
